glossary.quarantine: Move a folder into recoverable storage. This normally does not reclaim disk space.
glossary.permanent delete: Irreversible removal of an appdata folder or an exact ZFS dataset after explicit confirmation.
glossary.purge: Permanently remove a quarantined folder; also applies when its scheduled purge time arrives.
glossary.restore: Recover a quarantined folder or saved template without silently replacing an existing destination.
glossary.Safe Mode: Quarantine-first mode for movable folders. It is not a promise that all operations are reversible.
glossary.dry run: Preview the proposed action without performing filesystem changes.
glossary.template backup: Private saved container configuration, separate from appdata and sanitized support diagnostics.

phrases.source: Safe Mode moves folders to quarantine. Disable it only when you intentionally want permanent delete.
phrases.context: Dashboard mode card; distinguish recoverable quarantine from irreversible removal.

phrases.source: Quarantine moves folders and normally does not free space. Space is released only when data is permanently purged.
phrases.context: Quarantine confirmation; moving is not deletion or guaranteed space recovery.
Primary action for selected folders while Safe Mode is enabled.
Action/confirmation heading; must express irreversible removal.

phrases.source: Confirm the permanent delete before continuing.
phrases.context: Unchecked confirmation error; requires an explicit checkbox acknowledgement.
Quarantine manager action permanently deleting selected quarantined folders.
Permanent purge confirmation, not a move or restore.
Restore available destinations; conflicting entries stay in quarantine.
Restore beside existing folders using reviewed names; never overwrite them.
Cancel a confirmation without executing the action.

phrases.source: The operation stopped before its final result was recorded. Review recorded results and audit history, then rescan before taking further action.
phrases.context: Interrupted status is uncertainty, not proof of rollback or successful completion.

phrases.source: Configuration and backups survive uninstall. Private backup exports may contain credentials; keep them secure and do not attach them to support reports.
phrases.context: Template manager; distinguish private backups from sanitized diagnostics.

phrases.source: I understand these template backups will be permanently removed.
phrases.context: Explicit acknowledgement for removing recovery copies only.

phrases.source: Safe Mode changes the cleanup action. It does not bypass safety protection or incomplete ownership checks.
phrases.context: Dashboard mode card; changing action mode never authorizes protected data.

phrases.source: Review Specific container mounts in Details. Keep required mappings. Correct obsolete mappings in the container configuration, then rescan. Stopping the container or changing Safe Mode does not remove this protection.
phrases.context: Protected folder Details; do not suggest removing required mappings or stopping a container to bypass checks.

phrases.source: Rescan to repeat the ownership checks. If verification still fails, download diagnostics from Tools. Changing Safe Mode does not complete these checks.
phrases.context: Unverified folder Details; missing ownership evidence is not proof that data is unused.

phrases.source: Use Stop ignoring to include this folder in scan results again. This does not move or restore files.
phrases.context: Ignored folder Details; distinguish scan visibility from recovery of quarantined files.

phrases.source: The default applies to new folders and existing folders that follow the default, measured from when each folder entered quarantine. Older folders may already be due for permanent deletion. Zero disables default timers; manually set timers remain unchanged.
phrases.context: Expanded quarantine purge timer; positive defaults affect older eligible entries and zero does not clear individual timers.
